mina chowdhury: Hi folks  Mina here, joining Observability (IC2) today. Quick day-one asks so I don't block anyone:
- MDM for Apple Silicon (M1/M2)?
- Need a single external monitor + USB-C dock (I work SGT UTC+8 evenings).
- Please add me to the redwood-observability org (read) and #eng so I can follow team convos.
- Fun fact: I brew my own espresso and can nerd about beans forever. :coffee:

ev an (people ops): Welcome Mina!! :tada:
- MDM: enroll at https://mdm.redwood.example/enroll and pick "Company Mac - Apple Silicon" if you have an M1/M2. IT usually pushes the provisioning profile within ~30 mins of enrollment.
- Monitor/equipment: fill https://forms.redwood.example/equipment and select "monitor (single) + dock"; add "SGT evenings" in notes and we'll prioritize shipping.
- Org/Console: confirm the org slug (looks like "redwood-observability") and I'll file IAM + assign a buddy. DM me your shipping address for the welcome pack.

ravi (devex): Hey Mina  I'm your buddy for week one. Quick checklist:
- Add SSH pubkey: https://id.redwood.example/account/ssh-keys
- Test jump host: `ssh -i ~/.ssh/id_ed25519 mina@jump.redwood.com`
- VPN: use the redwood-wireguard profile; if you hit a cert error paste the exact message here and I'll triage. I can screenshare at 21:00 SGT to finish SSH/Console perms.

alisa (eng): Added you to #eng and put you in the oncall draft. For Console read, please submit the org request form and tag me so I can approve quicker.

asset-bot: Enrollment received for mina.c@example.com. Device: MacBookPro (arm64). Provisioning status: pending (approx 30m).

mina chowdhury: Thanks all  enrolling now and filling the equipment form. Ravi  21:00 SGT works great, I'll DM @evan my address for stickers. Also if anyone wants espresso recs, ping me in #random later. :sparkles:
